note: Fix pass 36 of pull request #296. By the maintainer's ruling of 2026-11-14, an inventory is owed only for changed code that guards trust or durability: here the attach rule in runLenses and the verifier's evidence renderings. Each claim ran against its named test alone. Three first claims for review.ts:1639 named the unlock test in probing-level.test.ts and survived it; the rows name the tests that kill them. The fourteen rows in notOwed are code this pass moved or trimmed without changing what it decides. Beyond the enumeration, the coordinator asked for the mutant that drops probesWith from selectionOf: it survived the live-writer test, which let the first run finish before the second review looked, so b977c4ff holds the first run live; the mutant then fails it (expected 0 to be greater than 0).
